gaps.sentence: She smiled ___ the waiter and ordered tea.
The press launched an attack ___ the minister's record.
Over two hundred athletes participated ___ the marathon.
gaps.explanation: participate IN an event (also: take part in).
believe IN something = think it exists/is right; believe somebody = trust their word.

gaps.sentence: Three workers were involved ___ the accident.
She's keen ___ joining the photography club.
He's not very friendly ___ his new colleagues.
gaps.explanation: friendly WITH somebody = on good terms; a friendly person is friendly TO others.
arrive IN towns, cities and countries; AT for buildings/points.
